<!--
This repository is a read-only release mirror. Pull requests cannot be
merged here: every release force-pushes a fresh orphan snapshot, so any PR
against `main` is overwritten and never lands. Please open an issue instead.
-->

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This repository does not accept pull requests.**
>
> It is a read-only release mirror — `main` is force-pushed on every
> release, so a PR against it can't be merged (it would be overwritten by
> the next snapshot).
>
> Please **[open an issue](https://github.com/cryndoc/polisade-orchestrator/issues/new/choose)**
> describing the bug or feature instead. Accepted changes are implemented in
> the upstream development repo and ship in the next release.
>
> Keep reports free of internal or sensitive data — issues here are public.
>
> Thanks for wanting to contribute!
